findings.title: Claude Desktop can run commands on your computer through 'desktop-commander'
findings.detail: The AI in Claude Desktop is connected to a tool that lets it run commands on your computer. If it reads a booby-trapped document or web page, an attacker could steer it to use that power.
findings.fix: Keep 'ask before running tools' turned on in Claude Desktop, and remove this tool connection if you don't use it.

findings.title: Possible AI trap in invoice.html
findings.detail: This file contains text written to give orders to an AI ("Ignore all previous instructions"); hidden formatting (white or invisible text). If you ask an AI assistant to read or summarize it, the AI may follow these hidden orders instead of yours.
findings.fix: Don't give this file to an AI assistant or agent. Delete it if you don't know where it came from.
